examples.text_en: He was fittingly given the best seat.
examples.text_zh: 他被恰如其分地安排在了最好的座位上。

examples.text_en: The day ended fittingly with a great song.
examples.text_zh: 这一天以一首动听的歌恰如其分地结束了。

examples.text_en: The baby would fixate on the light above.
examples.text_zh: 婴儿会盯着上方的灯看。

examples.text_en: He tends to fixate on one small problem.
examples.text_zh: 他容易纠结于一个小问题。

examples.text_en: The old table was a fixture in this room.
examples.text_zh: 那张旧桌子一直是这个房间里固定的家具。

examples.text_en: They put a new fixture in the front office.
examples.text_zh: 他们在前厅办公室装了一个新装置。

examples.text_en: His body was flabby from years of no work.
examples.text_zh: 由于多年不运动，他的身体变得松弛。

examples.text_en: He had flabby skin on both hands.
examples.text_zh: 他双手的皮肤松弛。

examples.text_en: The team gave a flaccid response to the plan.
examples.text_zh: 球队对这项计划作出了软弱无力的回应。

examples.text_en: His flaccid body could not lift the box.
examples.text_zh: 他软弱的身体举不起那个箱子。

examples.text_en: The flagella help these small things to move.
examples.text_zh: 鞭毛帮助这些微小的生物移动。

examples.text_en: They study the flagella under a strong light.
examples.text_zh: 他们在强光下研究鞭毛。

examples.text_en: They would flagellate him for what he said.
examples.text_zh: 他们会因为他所说的话鞭打他。

examples.text_en: The old law would flagellate those who did wrong.
examples.text_zh: 旧的律法会鞭挞那些做错事的人。

examples.text_en: The flagging on the road was old and broken.
examples.text_zh: 路面上的铺石又旧又破。

examples.text_en: They put new flagging across the whole street.
examples.text_zh: 他们给整条街铺上了新的石板。

examples.text_en: The flaggy land made it hard to walk.
examples.text_zh: 这片布满扁石的土地让人很难行走。

examples.text_en: We walked over flaggy ground near the water.
examples.text_zh: 我们走过水边那片松软多石的地面。

examples.text_en: It was a flagrant mistake and everyone knew it.
examples.text_zh: 这是个显而易见的错误，人人都看得出来。

examples.text_en: They called it a flagrant use of the old law.
examples.text_zh: 他们称这是对旧法律的公然滥用。

examples.text_en: A flail was kept in the small house.
examples.text_zh: 小房子里放着一把连枷。

examples.text_en: He made a flail out of an old part.
examples.text_zh: 他用一个旧部件做成了一把连枷。

examples.text_en: The flak filled the air above the city.
examples.text_zh: 高射炮火布满了城市上空。

examples.text_en: They could hear the flak all through the night.
examples.text_zh: 整夜都能听到高射炮的声音。

examples.text_en: He was known for his flamboyant way of talking.
examples.text_zh: 他以华丽张扬的说话方式著称。

examples.text_en: The flamboyant room was full of gold and red.
examples.text_zh: 这个华丽的房间满是金色和红色。

examples.text_en: A flaming light came from the old house.
examples.text_zh: 一道燃烧的火光从老房子里透出。

examples.text_en: They put out the flaming fire with water.
examples.text_zh: 他们用水扑灭了燃烧的大火。

examples.text_en: This old part is flammable, so keep it away.
examples.text_zh: 这个旧部件易燃，要放远一些。

examples.text_en: They must keep flammable things out of this room.
examples.text_zh: 他们必须把易燃物品搬出这个房间。

examples.text_en: A steel flange held the two parts together.
examples.text_zh: 一个钢制凸缘把两个部件固定在一起。

examples.text_en: They put a flange on the end of the pipe.
examples.text_zh: 他们在管子的末端装了一个凸缘。

examples.text_en: The dog bit him on the left flank.
examples.text_zh: 狗咬了他的左侧腹部。

examples.text_en: They moved around the flank of the old army.
examples.text_zh: 他们绕到那支旧军队的侧翼。

examples.text_en: He wore a flannel shirt and nothing else.
examples.text_zh: 他只穿了一件法兰绒衬衫。

examples.text_en: She used flannel to make a warm coat.
examples.text_zh: 她用法兰绒做了一件暖和的外套。

examples.text_en: A bright flare lit the dark sky above.
examples.text_zh: 一道明亮的闪光照亮了上方的夜空。

examples.text_en: The fire gave a sudden flare and then died.
examples.text_zh: 火猛地闪了一下，然后熄灭了。

examples.text_en: He drove a flashy car around the small town.
examples.text_zh: 他开着一辆花哨的汽车在小镇里转。

examples.text_en: Her flashy clothes made her easy to see.
examples.text_zh: 她一身炫目的衣服，很容易被人看到。

examples.text_en: They put the heavy box on the flatcar.
examples.text_zh: 他们把那个沉重的箱子搬上平板货车。

examples.text_en: A long flatcar stood on the old line.
examples.text_zh: 一节长长的平板货车停在旧线路上。

examples.text_en: The river runs through the wide flats near town.
examples.text_zh: 河流穿过镇附近的广阔平原。

examples.text_en: They walked across the flats at the water's edge.
examples.text_zh: 他们走过水边的平坦地带。

examples.text_en: The old house was flattened by the great storm.
examples.text_zh: 那所老房子被大风暴夷为平地。

examples.text_en: They flatten the land before they build the road.
examples.text_zh: 他们修路前先把土地整平。

examples.text_en: She likes to flaunt her gold ring at work.
examples.text_zh: 她喜欢在上班时炫耀她的金戒指。

examples.text_en: He would flaunt his new car to the team.
examples.text_zh: 他会向球队炫耀他的新车。

examples.text_en: She was flaunty and loved bright gold things.
examples.text_zh: 她很爱炫耀，喜欢闪闪发亮的金饰。

examples.text_en: His flaunty ways made the others feel small.
examples.text_zh: 他炫耀的做派让别人觉得自己很渺小。

examples.text_en: They grow flax to make fine cloth and oil.
examples.text_zh: 他们种植亚麻，用来制作细布和油。

examples.text_en: The fields were full of blue flax flowers.
examples.text_zh: 田野里开满了蓝色的亚麻花。

examples.text_en: They would flay the animal for its skin.
examples.text_zh: 他们会剥下这只动物的皮。

examples.text_en: He tried to flay the fish on the table.
examples.text_zh: 他想在桌上把鱼剥皮。

examples.text_en: There was a small fleck of dirt on it.
examples.text_zh: 上面有一小块污点。

examples.text_en: A black fleck was on the white wall.
examples.text_zh: 白墙上有一个黑色的斑点。

examples.text_en: The young birds will fledge in the warm season.
examples.text_zh: 幼鸟会在温暖的季节里长出羽毛。

examples.text_en: They watch the birds fledge each year.
examples.text_zh: 他们每年都看着这些鸟长出飞羽。

examples.text_zh: 一只刚会飞的幼鸟从高高的老树上掉了下来。

examples.text_en: He is still a fledgling in this hard work.
examples.text_zh: 在这项艰难的工作中，他还只是个新手。

examples.text_en: The fleece was soft and warm to the touch.
examples.text_zh: 这羊毛摸起来又软又暖。

examples.text_en: They took the fleece from the young sheep.
examples.text_zh: 他们从小羊身上剪下羊毛。

examples.text_zh: 整支舰队在黎明时离开了港口。

examples.text_en: A great fleet was seen near the south coast.
examples.text_zh: 有人在南部海岸附近看到一支庞大的舰队。

examples.text_en: It was only a fleeting look, and then she left.
examples.text_zh: 那只是匆匆一瞥，随后她就离开了。

examples.text_en: He had a fleeting hope that they would return.
examples.text_zh: 他短暂地希望他们会回来。

examples.text_en: The new plan gives us more flexibility at work.
examples.text_zh: 新计划让我们在工作中有了更多灵活性。

examples.text_en: They need flexibility in the way they work.
examples.text_zh: 他们需要在工作方式上灵活一些。

examples.text_en: She is flexible and can work at any time.
examples.text_zh: 她很灵活，任何时候都能工作。

examples.text_en: The old part is flexible and easy to move.
examples.text_zh: 这个旧部件柔韧，容易移动。

examples.text_en: A faint flicker of light came from the fire.
examples.text_zh: 火中透出微弱的光在闪动。

examples.text_en: They saw the flicker of a light far away.
examples.text_zh: 他们看见远处有一点光在闪烁。

examples.text_en: She was too flighty to keep a steady job.
examples.text_zh: 她太轻浮，难以长久地做一份工作。

examples.text_en: His flighty ways made the team feel unsure.
examples.text_zh: 他飘忽不定的作风让球队心里没底。

examples.text_en: The old box was flimsy and fell apart.
examples.text_zh: 那个旧盒子很脆弱，散了架。

examples.text_en: They gave a flimsy reason for the mistake.
examples.text_zh: 他们为这个错误给出了一个站不住脚的理由。

examples.text_en: He did not flinch when the dog ran at him.
examples.text_zh: 当狗向他扑来时，他没有退缩。

examples.text_en: She would flinch at every sudden sound.
examples.text_zh: 每当有突然的声响，她都会一惊。

examples.text_zh: 他用打火石和钢片生起了火。

examples.text_zh: 老人在那里找到了一块打火石。

examples.text_zh: 他轻率的回答让整个房间安静下来。

examples.text_en: She was flippant about a very serious matter.
examples.text_zh: 她对一件非常严肃的事态度轻率。

examples.text_en: The birds flit from tree to tree at morning.
examples.text_zh: 清晨，鸟儿在树间飞来飞去。

examples.text_en: A small light seemed to flit across the wall.
examples.text_zh: 一道微光似乎掠过墙面。

examples.text_en: They opened the floodgate to let the water out.
examples.text_zh: 他们打开水闸放水。

examples.text_en: The old floodgate could not hold the water back.
examples.text_zh: 那道旧水闸挡不住水了。

examples.text_en: The river covers the floodplain in the wet season.
examples.text_zh: 雨季时河水会淹没这片泛滥平原。

examples.text_en: They built their house on the wide floodplain.
examples.text_zh: 他们把房子建在宽阔的泛滥平原上。

examples.text_en: The flora of this land is rich and old.
examples.text_zh: 这片土地的植物群丰富而古老。

examples.text_en: They study the local flora near the sea.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究海边当地的植物群。

examples.text_zh: 她穿着一条花朵图案的连衣裙去参加聚会。

examples.text_en: The room had a light floral smell.
examples.text_zh: 房间里有一股淡淡的花香。

examples.text_en: The florescence of these plants comes in spring.
examples.text_zh: 这些植物的花期在春天。

examples.text_en: They watch the florescence with great interest.
examples.text_zh: 他们饶有兴趣地观察开花的过程。

examples.text_en: His face was florid from the long hot walk.
examples.text_zh: 走了很长的热路，他的脸色通红。

examples.text_en: The florid writing was full of long, fine words.
examples.text_zh: 这篇文章辞藻华丽，满是冗长的词句。

examples.text_en: The team began to flounder after the first loss.
examples.text_zh: 首场失利后，这支队伍开始挣扎。

examples.text_en: He would flounder when they asked hard questions.
examples.text_zh: 他们问难题时，他就会手足无措。

examples.text_en: The flourishment of the town brought many people.
examples.text_zh: 小镇的繁荣吸引了许多人。

examples.text_en: They talked about the flourishment of the arts.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈到了艺术的兴盛。

examples.text_en: He would flout the old rules and do as he liked.
examples.text_zh: 他会无视旧规矩，想怎么做就怎么做。

examples.text_en: They flout the law and feel no shame.
examples.text_zh: 他们藐视法律，毫不觉得羞愧。

examples.text_zh: 今天价格出现了小幅波动。

examples.text_en: The fluctuation of the water level is easy to see.
examples.text_zh: 水位的变化很容易看出来。

examples.text_zh: 这次获胜纯属侥幸，我们心里都清楚。

examples.text_en: By a fluke, they found the lost ring.
examples.text_zh: 他们偶然间找到了丢失的戒指。

examples.text_en: The room was lit by a long fluorescent light.
examples.text_zh: 房间里亮着一盏长条荧光灯。

examples.text_en: They used a fluorescent light to see the mark.
examples.text_zh: 他们用荧光灯来看清那个标记。

examples.text_zh: 这个坏消息让整个团队陷入慌乱。

examples.text_en: She was in a fluster before the big test.
examples.text_zh: 大考之前，她慌乱不安。

examples.text_zh: 他们问他原因时，他显得很慌张。

examples.text_en: She felt flustered and could not find the words.
examples.text_zh: 她心慌意乱，找不到合适的词。

examples.text_en: The flag gave a small flutter in the wind.
examples.text_zh: 旗子在风中轻轻飘动。

examples.text_en: Her heart gave a flutter when he came in.
examples.text_zh: 他进来时，她的心猛地一跳。

examples.text_zh: 河边的河流冲积地非常肥沃。

examples.text_en: They study fluvial systems in this part of the world.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究世界这一地区的河流系统。

examples.text_en: The whole system was in a state of flux.
examples.text_zh: 整个体系处于不断变化之中。

examples.text_en: Our plans are still in flux this week.
examples.text_zh: 我们这周的计划仍未确定。

examples.text_zh: 他们建了一座立交桥来缓解繁忙的道路。

examples.text_en: The car went over the new flyover at speed.
examples.text_zh: 汽车快速驶过新建的立交桥。

examples.text_en: There was a small flyspeck on the white page.
examples.text_zh: 白页上有一个小污点。

examples.text_en: He could not see the flyspeck from far away.
examples.text_zh: 从远处他看不到那个小斑点。

examples.text_en: White foam was on the top of the water.
examples.text_zh: 水面上浮着白色的泡沫。

examples.text_en: The soap made a lot of foam in the cup.
examples.text_zh: 肥皂在杯子里产生了大量泡沫。

examples.text_zh: 他们给动物准备了过冬的干草料。

examples.text_en: The old food was used as fodder for the cows.
examples.text_zh: 那些旧食物被用作奶牛的饲料。

examples.text_zh: 他在整个广阔的世界里没有敌人。

examples.text_en: The two were foe and would never make peace.
examples.text_zh: 这两人是仇敌，永远不会和解。

examples.text_zh: 旧窗户蒙上了雾，很难看清。

examples.text_en: His mind felt fogged after the long night.
examples.text_zh: 漫漫长夜之后，他觉得脑子一片模糊。

examples.text_en: The foghorn gave a loud sound over the water.
examples.text_zh: 雾号在水面上发出响亮的鸣声。

examples.text_en: We could hear the foghorn all through the night.
examples.text_zh: 整夜我们都能听到雾号声。

examples.text_zh: 生活中每个人都有那么一两个小缺点。

examples.text_zh: 他唯一的缺点就是喜欢旧车。

examples.text_zh: 金色的箔纸让盒子看起来非常精致。

examples.text_en: They used foil to keep the food warm.
examples.text_zh: 他们用箔纸给食物保温。

examples.text_en: The foliage of the old trees was very thick.
examples.text_zh: 那些老树的枝叶非常茂密。

examples.text_en: Bright red foliage was all around the small house.
examples.text_zh: 小房子的四周满是鲜红的树叶。

examples.text_en: The old folklore of this town is well known.
examples.text_zh: 这个小镇的古老民间传说广为人知。

examples.text_en: She studies folklore and writes about the old ways.
examples.text_zh: 她研究民俗，并撰写关于旧习俗的文章。

examples.text_zh: 他们试图在两个队之间挑起争斗。

examples.text_en: He would foment trouble wherever he went.
examples.text_zh: 他走到哪里都会煽动事端。

examples.text_zh: 她会抚弄那只小狗好几个小时。

examples.text_zh: 他喜欢抚摸婴儿柔软的头发。

examples.text_zh: 他们在高地上站稳了脚跟。

examples.text_zh: 他失去落脚点，掉进了水里。

examples.text_en: His forebears came from a small town.
examples.text_zh: 他的祖先来自一个小镇。

examples.text_en: They talked about the forebears of the family.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈起了这个家族的祖先。

examples.text_en: The dark sky seemed to forebode a great storm.
examples.text_zh: 阴暗的天空似乎预示着一场大风暴。

examples.text_en: Such news would forebode hard times for them.
examples.text_zh: 这样的消息预示着他们艰难的日子即将到来。

examples.text_en: The bank would foreclose on the old house.
examples.text_zh: 银行会取消那所老房子的抵押赎回权。

examples.text_en: They tried to foreclose before the end of the year.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图在年底前取消赎回权。

examples.text_en: His forefathers built this house long ago.
examples.text_zh: 他的祖先很久以前建造了这所房子。

examples.text_en: The forefathers of the town were hard men.
examples.text_zh: 这个镇的先辈都是坚强的人。

examples.text_en: She was at the forefront of the new work.
examples.text_zh: 她站在这项新工作的最前线。

examples.text_en: They put the young man at the forefront.
examples.text_zh: 他们让这个年轻人站到了最前面。

examples.text_en: He had no foreknowledge of the coming change.
examples.text_zh: 他对即将到来的变化毫无预知。

examples.text_en: With foreknowledge, they were ready for the test.
examples.text_zh: 由于事先知晓，他们对这次考验早有准备。

examples.text_en: She is one of the foremost writers of our time.
examples.text_zh: 她是我们这个时代最重要的作家之一。

examples.text_en: Their safety was foremost in his mind.
examples.text_zh: 他们的安全是他最看重的事。

examples.text_en: The forensic work helped the court find the truth.
examples.text_zh: 法证工作帮助法庭查明了真相。

examples.text_en: They used forensic skills to look at the old case.
examples.text_zh: 他们运用法证技能重新审视这桩旧案。

examples.text_en: This small car was a forerunner of the new kind.
examples.text_zh: 这款小车是新型车的前身。

examples.text_en: He was a forerunner of the whole green movement.
examples.text_zh: 他是整个环保运动的先驱。

examples.text_en: They could not see any change in the foreseeable time.
examples.text_zh: 在可预见的时期内，他们看不到任何变化。

examples.text_en: The plan is safe for the foreseeable future.
examples.text_zh: 在可预见的未来，这个计划是安全的。

examples.text_en: The first loss would foreshadow a hard season.
examples.text_zh: 首场失利预示着艰难的赛季。

examples.text_en: Dark clouds foreshadow a change in the weather.
examples.text_zh: 乌云预示着天气的变化。

examples.text_en: With great foresight, they saved money early.
examples.text_zh: 凭着远见，他们早早地存下了钱。

examples.text_en: His foresight made the whole project a success.
examples.text_zh: 他的远见使整个项目取得了成功。

examples.text_en: They moved fast to forestall the coming problem.
examples.text_zh: 他们迅速行动，预先阻止了即将到来的问题。

examples.text_en: He tried to forestall any talk of change.
examples.text_zh: 他试图阻止任何关于变革的讨论。

examples.text_en: They study forestry to take better care of the land.
examples.text_zh: 他们学习林业，以便更好地照料土地。

examples.text_en: The forestry work gave jobs to many local people.
examples.text_zh: 林业工作为许多当地人提供了就业。

examples.text_en: He wrote a short foreword for the new book.
examples.text_zh: 他为这本新书写了一篇简短的前言。

examples.text_en: The foreword of the book was by a famous man.
examples.text_zh: 这本书的前言出自一位名人之手。
